Returns 200 { rebased: true, message: 'Rebase successful' } on successful rebase
Returns 409 { rebased: false, conflicts: [...], message: 'Rebase aborted due to conflicts' } on conflict
Done stage delegates to mergeQueue.retry()

Emits rebase_progress events during fetching and rebasing steps
